frameworkSpecification: W021.5 Polling Station & Electoral Roll Crosswalk Architecture Framework
directive: CTO Directive 148 / Workstream C / Task EB-05
governingAuthority: Master Execution Framework Amendment v1.6 / Rule IV-001 Non-Self-Acceptance

statutoryFramework.governingStatute: Section 25 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951
statutoryFramework.districtElectionOfficerRole: The District Election Officer (DEO) provides a sufficient number of polling stations for each assembly constituency with prior approval of the Election Commission of India.

electoralRollHierarchy.statutoryCode: part_no (Identical to or partitioned from PS)

statutoryFramework.strictNestingInvariant: By statutory definition under Section 25 of RPA 1951, a Polling Station and Electoral Roll Part is strictly and 100% nested inside exactly ONE Assembly Constituency. Unlike postal PIN codes, Polling Stations NEVER cross AC boundaries.

proposedSchema.constituency_id: TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES public.constituencies(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

channel1_eciElectorSearchApi.mechanism: EPIC (Voter ID) search returns State, District, AC Number, AC Name, Part Number, Part Name, and Polling Station.
channel1_eciElectorSearchApi.authoritativeQuality: 100% authoritative primary source directly from the National Electoral Roll (ERNET)
channel1_eciElectorSearchApi.rateLimitAndAccessRestrictions: Protected by CAPTCHA and rate limits; bulk programmatic harvesting requires institutional API authorization.

channel2_stateCeoElectoralRollPdfs.provider: Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) State Portals (e.g. ceotelangana.nic.in, ceoandhra.nic.in)
channel2_stateCeoElectoralRollPdfs.mechanism: Annual final publication of draft/electoral roll PDFs (Form 20 and Electoral Roll Parts) organized by AC and Part Number.
channel2_stateCeoElectoralRollPdfs.authoritativeQuality: Official statutory public documents published under Registration of Electors Rules, 1960.

disposition.nextPermittedStep: Integrate voter EPIC lookup via official CEO/ECI voter search endpoints when institutional access credentials are authenticated.
